gloss_en: Eden (עֵדֶן) — the proper name of the supernal paradise-source of Genesis 2:10 ('a river goes forth from Eden'), which in Likutey Moharan is the hidden realm 'no eye has seen' (Berakhot 34b): the transcendent source above nature and beyond grasp, homiletically identified with prayer, the ultimate purpose/nullification, and the supernal Eden — not the common noun עֵדֶן 'delight/pleasure' nor any other word from the root עדן
